Discover how trusted AI can help tax teams reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and respond to change while maintaining governance and confidence.

AI is creating new opportunities for tax teams, but successful adoption requires more than simply automating existing processes. Tax organizations also need confidence in the data, decisions, and results produced with AI.


In this on-demand webinar, Vertex experts explore how organizations can apply AI across tax workflows to reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and adapt more quickly to change. The discussion also examines why explainability, governance, and trusted data are particularly important when applying AI to tax.


Watch the webinar to explore practical considerations for bringing trusted AI into your tax operations.


## Learning Objective:


- Why tax requires a higher standard for AI, including explainability, governance, and trusted data.
- How AI can help tax teams reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
- Ways AI can help teams find answers faster and keep classifications accurate.
- How organizations can use AI to adapt more efficiently to tax change.
- Why maintaining oversight and confidence in AI-supported results remains essential.
